question: The ICMR/NIN 2020 recommended dietary allowance (RDA) for Vitamin C in infants and children up to adolescence is 40 mg/day.

l10n.wrongAnswerMessage: This is true. The ICMR/NIN 2020 sets the Vitamin C RDA at 40 mg/day for infants and children (adolescents: 65 mg/day). Remember that boiling destroys ~50% of Vitamin C in vegetables, which is why cooking methods are a significant cause of deficiency in Indian diets.
l10n.correctAnswerMessage: Correct. The ICMR/NIN (2020) RDA for Vitamin C is 40 mg/day for infants and young children. Adolescents have a higher recommendation of 65 mg/day. This is notably lower than the US RDA, which reflects the ICMR reference body-weight adjustments.
